name: Bubble Gum Simulator
creator: Rumble Studios
redeem: Launch the original Bubble Gum Simulator on Roblox, not Bubble Gum Simulator Infinity, and wait for your character to load.
Click the blue Twitter-bird Codes button in the upper-left corner of the screen.
Click the Code Here box in the window that opens.
Type or paste the code exactly as written, including capital letters, and press the green Enter button.
notes:
Bubble Gum Simulator is the original bubble-blowing simulator from Rumble Studios, separate from its newer Infinity sequel. You chew gum to grow your bubble, sell it for coins, and put those coins into better gum and flavors so your bubble can carry you higher to the floating islands above the map. Hatching eggs gives you pets that multiply what you earn.

Codes in this game nearly always hand out timed boosts such as 2x Luck, 2x Hatch Speed or extra shiny chance, lasting anywhere from minutes to several hours. They work best stacked with the weekend 2x Luck and Hatch Speed event before a long egg-hatching session. New codes tend to arrive with seasonal updates and are printed in the game description.

faq.q: Do these codes work in Bubble Gum Simulator Infinity?
faq.a: No. The original Bubble Gum Simulator and its Infinity sequel are separate games. Redeem these codes in the original Bubble Gum Simulator by Rumble Studios.

faq.q: When is the best time to use the FallPart2 and Wayfarer boosts?
faq.a: Both codes give 4 hours of 2x Luck and 2x Hatch Speed. The game also turns on 2x Luck and 2x Hatch Speed every Friday through Sunday, starting and ending at 12AM PST, so redeeming the codes during that weekend event before a long egg-hatching session gets the most out of them.

tips: Spend your first coins on better gum and flavors. Bigger bubbles sell for more and let you float higher to reach new islands.
Sell your bubble whenever it is full instead of waiting. Selling often keeps your coins growing in the early game.
Hatch eggs as often as you can afford, and equip the pets with the biggest bonuses. Pets multiply what you earn.
Check the game page for new events, eggs and secret pets. The game also adds hat crates, so there is more to collect than just pets.
useRewards: FallPart2 and Wayfarer each give 4 hours of 2x Luck and 2x Hatch Speed. Since the timers keep running, redeem them only when you can stay in the game and hatch for a long stretch. Have enough coins saved for plenty of eggs first, so you are not stuck selling bubbles while the boost runs out. Luck boosts matter most when you are chasing a secret pet from the newest egg.
